items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: George Lewis? Oh, he was good when he was with me and Kid Allen.

ctx.x: Oh, well, some of them are like, uh, Brian Freddie, and, uh, Johnny Dot, and, uh, Jimmy Loon. You remember Jimmy Loon? And he's dead, too, isn't he? Yeah. And, uh, let me see, uh, and Jeff, and, uh, Big Eye Louie, and Johnny Handy. And, uh, he sure has, and, uh, Big Eye Louie, and, uh, and Johnny Handy. And, uh, then they had a whole lot of youngsters, you know, they come up with the jazz, too, you know. Yeah. I can't remember the name of it. Ask him when George Lewis began to get good. When did George Lewis…
George Lewis? Oh, he was good when he was with me and Kid Allen.

Yeah. And we used to play with some band before me and George. Oh, with Oral Lumpus band. We played. Then we left Oral Lumpus band. We played. Then we left Oral Lumpus band. We played. Then we left Oral Lumpus band. We was good then. And we tried to get him to go on site. He tried once, but he didn't like it until he got back on Clionette. Then Clionette come back, but she didn't have nothing to do with that. What's that name? Emile or something? Yeah. Millie Bond. Millie Bond. Millie Bond.
